newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania approves Butinges terminal share issue.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania approves Butinges terminal share issue.

text.p: The Lithuanian government on Wednesday approved the Butinges oil terminal's plan to boost its share capital to 261 million litas from 71.27 million litas.
"The cabinet has approved the share capital increase in Butinges nafta," the government said in a statement.
The government recently said that it planned to reduce its majority stake in the oil terminal project to 34 percent.
Construction of the terminal, which will be used primarily to export Russian oil supplies to Western markets, is scheduled for completion in 1998.
Potential investors want Butinges to guarantee that Russian suppliers will use its facilities.
